tasks.title: Define the reusable pre/post transition witness
tasks.goal: Supply the source-applicability contract needed by scoped existing-file production.
steps: Consume the M-03-C production request/invocation and continuation carriers; do not wait for brownfield proposal/promotion.
Define retained pre-input witnesses, declared write membership, exact consumed artifact identities, post-output witnesses and outside-write equality in a distinct transition recipe.
Register generated carriers/hash frames; keep legacy pre-input records recognizable and classify new/deleted paths explicitly.
positive_cases: A transition names the exact pre-state consumed and post-state produced.
Disjoint and existing-file changes share the same explicit identity law.
negative_cases: A renamed fingerprint cannot masquerade as causal evidence.
Missing pre-state, undeclared writes or consumed-artifact drift refuses transition acceptance.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-lifecycle <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
acceptance: Corpus distinguishes legacy evidence, produced transition and explicit adopted authority.
Hash recipe includes membership and consumed inputs rather than only output bytes.

tasks.title: Enforce produced and adopted transition ownership
tasks.goal: Validate the source transition at hosted/local completion without granting authority from matching files.
steps: At completion/resume, compare pre-witnesses, actual write membership, outside-write equality and exact consumed artifacts under the existing lease.
Persist a produced transition only for the matching production request; make adoption an explicit authority-bearing path with its own evidence kind.
Retain old/pre-state evidence and refuse stale/foreign outputs without rerunning a producer automatically.
positive_cases: A matching hosted resume accepts a declared existing-file modification.
Explicitly authorized adoption records adopted authority without claiming producer execution.
negative_cases: Foreign request, unchanged-but-unowned output, outside-write edit or missing prior witness refuses.
A failed validation cannot displace another parked continuation or rewrite old measurements.

tasks.title: Make post-create verification causal and convergent
tasks.goal: Refresh current-source checks without recreating already accepted production or laundering predecessor evidence.
steps: Integrate transition applicability into the pre-handler prefix gate, not only a verify handler that the gate may never reach.
On explicit next verification invocation, recompute needed deterministic build/test evidence for current source while preserving the accepted production request and its pre/post witness.
Demonstrate convergence: first production changes an existing input, verify checks new bytes, repeated fresh verify performs no new production; report unsupported overlaps honestly.
positive_cases: Current-source build/test subjects match the produced post-state.
Repeated verification remains fresh without gratuitous create.
negative_cases: Old pre-create tests cannot establish post-create correctness.
Outside-write/consumed-artifact drift, missing check or stale legacy evidence blocks acceptance rather than forcing an automatic loop.
